brands.name: 100 Percent Surfboards
brands.short_description: Third-generation custom surfboards shaped in-house by Rodney and Tom Bedford in Moana, South Australia.

models.name: Hang 'Em High
models.description: All round high performance, designed for radical, in-the-pocket surfing and aerial ability. The outline and tail lift allow for drive and control, with a slight hip in the tail. Great for airs and adding flair to aggressive turns.

models.name: JayBee Transition Single
models.description: Harking back to a traditional styled outline from a time when boards evolved from the 8 foot toward the 7 foot range. This is suitable for a cruisy type of surfing that produces long flowing turns and a relaxing ride all the way to the beach.

models.name: Jaybee Longboard
models.description: A more traditional style of longboard for smooth flowing turns and easy gliding. A variable flatter rocker will be tweaked to suit the surfer with a focus on cruising or turning. Perfect for small clean days and a lot of fun.

models.name: Pintail Twin
models.description: Modern-retro design with optional channels and optional glassed-in, hand-made retro fins. Your choice of FCS or Future Fin plugs installed.

models.name: Step Up
models.description: Designed for bigger, more powerful waves. Ideal step-up board. More length and thickness allows for catching fast-moving heavy waves, with slightly more flowing rocker and an outline for surfers who want to take an advanced approach to bigger waves.
